# BCA Leadership

> Pan-African leadership network. BCA helps leaders of companies become better leaders through executive coaching, peer learning, consulting, project management, and business matching. 45 world-class and award-winning coaches and trainers across all five regions of Africa and the diaspora, serving 5,000+ leaders since 2017. Based in Grand Baie, Mauritius.

## What BCA offers
- Executive coaching — individual, group, and organizational, with certified coaches.
- Peer learning — monthly cohorts, speaker series, and Needs & Leads matchmaking.
- Consulting — leadership, management, organizational, and governance.
- Project management — conferences, retreats, and workshops.
- Business matching — capital, partners, expertise, market entry, and mediation.

## Membership (annual billing; agreements are signed on the website)
- Basic — $600/yr. Rising executives and founders. Monthly peer cohort, BCAOnline access, Needs & Leads, member rates for the Made in Africa Leadership Conference (MLC).
- Executive — $1,600/yr. Adds 4 private coaching sessions per year.
- Platinum — $2,800/yr. 12 private coaching sessions, 12 cohort meetings, choose your coach, MLC pass, business matching across 15+ countries.
- Corporate plans from $10,000/yr.

## Coaching packages (standalone)
- 4 sessions $1,000 · 6 sessions $1,400 · 12 sessions $2,500, with a certified coach from the 45-person bench.

## About
- Founded 2017. Flagship event: the Made in Africa Leadership Conference (MLC).
- 63% of member CEOs report revenue growth above 10%.
- An AI concierge on the website answers questions in English, French, Spanish, and Portuguese and can guide visitors to join or book coaching directly.
